key.name: disable-on-battery
key.description: When enabled, AOD will be disabled when running on battery power and the screen will blank normally.

key.name: aod-timeout
key.description: Time in minutes before the screen blanks after entering AOD mode. 0 means AOD stays on indefinitely.

key.name: software-dimming
key.summary: Dim in software instead of changing the backlight (useful for OLED)
key.description: When enabled, AOD dims the lock screen by reducing its opacity over the black background instead of changing the display backlight. Useful with OLED displays.

key.name: brightness-reduction
key.description: Brightness level when in AOD mode, as a percentage of the normal brightness. Applies to whichever dimming method is selected.

key.name: idle-delay
key.description: Time in seconds of inactivity on the lock screen before AOD re-activates after user interaction.

key.name: fade-in-time
key.description: Duration of the fade animation when entering AOD mode (background fading to black).

key.name: fade-out-time
key.description: Duration of the fade animation when exiting AOD mode (background appearing).
